Write this the way you would explain the change to someone who has to review it.
Why it exists and how you know it works are the parts the diff cannot show.
Skip anything a reviewer could reconstruct by reading the code.

`make test` and `make lint` are expected to be clean. CI runs both on Linux and
macOS, so there is no need to say that they passed; say it only if something
about running them is unusual.

If this changes user-visible behavior, the docs move with it, and
docs/reference.md and schema/faultline.schema.json are generated by `make docs`.

CONTRIBUTING.md has the rest.
-->
